text:
elaine: Quick sync after the postmortemwe need an operational playbook + small experiments to reduce partial responses and flapping reconnects. Dropping owners & next steps here.

elaine: Problem summary: intermittent partial streams when clients reconnect quickly; reconnections sometimes trigger duplicate sessions and backend marks stream closed early. Suspected contributors: uneven client retry budgets, no per-stream heartbeat, and missing final-ACK from server side.

matt: i'll own the client-side bits (retry budget + trace propagation). plan: add per-stream retry budget with a sliding window and a soft circuit-breaker that disables retries for 30s after 5 failures. also will add header `x-rdinference-retry-id` to correlate attempts. ETA: initial PR in 48h.

sri: i'll prototype server-side final-ack frame and optional tail buffer (hold last 200ms for extra frames). config `stream.tail_hold_ms`. will run mem+latency bench. prototype in 4d.

julia: observability owner here. will create a lightweight streaming dashboard: charts for `stream.partial_ratio`, `stream.reconnects_by_client`, `stream.tail_held_count`. also wire up a trace view that surfaces `x-rdinference-retry-id`. ETA: next Monday.

henry: infra will check L7 vs L4 proxy behavior; some partners use a proxy that collapses keepalive, causing mid-stream resets. i'll run controlled tests on canary cluster and report findings.

zack: i'll update the incident page and add playbook steps: (1) check last-100 chunk timestamps, (2) grep for repeated retry-id across sessions, (3) escalate to infra if proxy observed. adding rotation for stream incidents.

elaine: action list condensed: A) client retry budget + header (matt), B) server tail buffer + final-ack (sri), C) telemetry + dashboard + alerts (julia), D) proxy/keepalive testing (henry), E) playbook + comms (zack). expected short-term goal: halve partial rate in 2 weeks.

matt: design note: retry budget pseudocode:
```
if attempts_in_window(client_id, 60s) > 5: open_circuit(client_id, 30s)
else: attempt_retry()
```
will log `x-rdinference-retry-id` on every attempt.

sri: server tail buffer approach: mark last-chunk candidates as "tentative" and wait `stream.tail_hold_ms` for trailing frames or final-ack. if ack arrives, commit; else mark partial and emit event. default tail_hold_ms=200.

julia: alert proposal: page-on `stream.partial_rate > 1% for 5m` and slack-only for `>0.3% for 10m`. adding a burn-in alert for reconnect storms: `reconnects/min > 200` triggers P1.

henry: infra test plan: 1) baseline 24h, 2) run synthetic reconnect flood (500 clients/min) on canary, 3) toggle keepalive & proxy settings, 4) measure partial delta. will schedule Wed 09:00 PT.

zack: ops-bot can you create tickets and add due dates? I'll also add a scheduled check-in calendar invite.

ops-bot: Created INF-3401 (client retry budget + retry-id header) -> assignee: matt, due: 2d. Created INF-3402 (server tail buffer + final-ack) -> assignee: sri, due: 5d. Created INF-3403 (streaming dashboard + alerts) -> assignee: julia, due: 7d. Created INF-3404 (proxy keepalive canary tests) -> assignee: henry, due: 4d. Created INF-3405 (stream incident playbook update) -> assignee: zack, due: 3d. Follow-ups scheduled: every 2 weeks for 6 weeks.

matt: flagged mobile SDK owner as potential blockermobile apps may need extra time to adopt retry header. will include feature flag for mobile rollout.

sri: memory check: tail buffer opt-in for 2 weeks on canary; will capture p95 memory and connection churn.

julia: req: please add `x-rdinference-retry-id` to any client re-open; matt can you ensure proxies don't strip it? henry to validate.

henry: notedsome proxies drop arbitrary `x-` headers by default. adding config to preserve the header on the canary path.

zack: scheduling 30m sync next Tue 10:30 to review canary telemetry. please add short updates to INF tickets as you make progress.

elaine: blockers checklist: mobile rollout (matt), proxy header preservation (henry), server memory delta (sri). tag any other blockers now.

matt: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/501 adds retry budget logic + header. tagging sri for tests.

sri: starting tail buffer prototype now; will post bench numbers to INF-3402.

julia: creating dashboard doc and will wire alerts to paging rules. linking INF tickets to central postmortem.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync on 1753700000 (two weeks).

elaine: thanks all. goal: reduce customer-facing partials and reduce firefights. we'll adjust cadence based on canary metrics. :rocket:
